site_name: Leighton House Museum, 12 Holland Park Road, LONDON, W14 8LZ
description: Removal and replacement of stone treads and metal balustrades to front entrance; front forecourt landscaping works including removal of laightwell railings and replacement with new horizontal inlet grille; removal and replacement of front gates; installation of new gate between main house and Perrin Wing Forecourt, ramped access to left of front steps; installation of two additional cycle hoops; installation of opening rooflight to Winter Studio; installation of timber side gate; installation of new lettering above museum entrance and installation of new illuminated lettering to front boundary wall; landscaping works to rear garden including new paths and replacement shed in north east corner.
